python3 - <<'PY'
import json,base64, pathlib
p=pathlib.Path('.tmp/seek_shoot_response.json')
resp=json.loads(p.read_text())
for name,key in [('during','during'),('post','post')]:
    d=resp.get(key) or {}
    b64=d.get('png_base64')
    if not b64:
        raise SystemExit(f'missing {key} png_base64: {d}')
    out=pathlib.Path('.tmp')/f'swipe_seek_{name}.png'
    out.write_bytes(base64.b64decode(b64))
    print(out, d.get('width'), d.get('height'))
PY
